cases.name: Maria Telles-Gonzalez
cases.about: She was of Puerto Rican ancestry and had been known as the Beaufort County “Jane Doe” for 27 years.
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE UNSOLVED; FORENSIC INVESTIGATIVE GENETIC GENEALOGY ID'D HER
cases.narrative: On 5/24/1995, state employees who were mowing grass found her body, wearing only underwear, face down in a drainage ditch on Cotton Hall Road off Interstate 95 in Yemassee, SC.
